title: Sim City 2020 — Building & Infrastructure Art Catalogue

assets.name: Residential
assets.currentAppearance: Textured rectangular mass, horizontal floor strips, balconies and roof details. Low-density houses are not yet separate pitched-roof models.
assets.artStatus: Artwork brief — detailed replacement asset not yet built
assets.silhouette: Warm neighborhood houses progressing to articulated housing towers
assets.facadeAndMaterials: Painted lap siding and brick at low density; recessed windows, stone piers, staggered balconies and curtains at higher density
assets.siteAndProps: Porches, fences, mailboxes, gardens, driveway parking and continuous sidewalks
assets.nightWeatherAnimation: Occupied windows vary independently; porch lamps stay warm; roof snow and wet paving follow the environment
assets.growthRule: 3 supplied months per phase, with demand and happiness gates
